captureFields: Platform, model, interface and search/grounding mode
Observed competitors and first-party vs independent source
queryTestingFramework.cadence: Establish a small fixed prompt set, repeat across separate sessions, review monthly and compare only like-for-like conditions.
queryTestingFramework.interpretation: Report observed counts with sample size and context; no market-wide share of voice or revenue causation from a small prompt panel.
suggestedWorkflow: Select buyer-relevant branded and unbranded intents.
Run and archive the same prompts across the five environments under documented conditions.
Separate brand mention, recommendation, source citation and citation correctness.
Investigate missing or misleading evidence before changing content.
Connect referral sessions and qualified outcomes where observable; revisit the strategy every 90 days.

guardrails: Google says no special schema or AI text files are required for its AI features.
Do not generalize Google eligibility rules to all AI platforms.
Structured data is not a prerequisite for an AI system to read text or cite a page.
No actual AI outputs, rankings, citation frequencies or visibility percentages are present.
A mention, citation, visit and purchase are different events; preserve those distinctions.
Do not create inauthentic third-party mentions, fake reviews or deceptive community engagement.
